dct_description_sm: This file contains water quality data for a shallow, eutrophic reservoir in the Great Plains of North America for the 2016–2019 period. A suite of water quality indicators were sampled at eight locations along the length of the lake during the open water period. Analytes include: total dissolved nitrogen, dissolved organic carbon, chlorophyl a, turbidity, extinction coefficient and Secchi depth. Dissolved organic matter characteristics (specific ultraviolet absorbance, absorbance at 254 nm, freshness index (BA), fluorescence index, humification index, spectral slope, peaks A, C and T, and spectral peak ratios A:T and C:A) were determined using excitation-emission matrices. These data were used to understand intra and interannual behaviour of dissolved organic carbon as water transits through this flow-managed system used as a drinking water source.
